messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into German, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
O Ehre und Licht der anderen Dichter, Gewähre mir das lange Studium und die große Liebe die mich veranlasst haben, dein Werk zu suchen.

Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally).
